name: The Accessible Stall
description: Two disabled friends discuss disability topics, share stories, and interview guests. Funny, honest, and thought-provoking conversations about living with a disability.

name: Disability After Dark
description: Shining a bright light on what it's like to live with a disability, covering everything from relationships and parenting to travel and advocacy.

name: Parenting Special Needs Podcast
description: Practical tips, life lessons, challenges, and joys of parenting children with special needs — from the creators of Parenting Special Needs Magazine.

name: Parenting Impossible: The Special Needs Survival Podcast
description: Honest, real conversations about the chaos and beauty of raising kids with disabilities — covering therapies, IEPs, marriage, self-care, and everything in between.

name: Once Upon a Gene
description: Conversations with rare disease parents, disabled adults, caregivers, and professionals — honest stories about parenting, identity, and advocacy in the rare disease world.

name: 2 Pancakes of Wisdom
description: Welcome to the wild, ridiculous, and completely out of control adventure that is called special needs parenting. The kind of “all your child will eat are frozen pancakes from Trader Joe’s, and they are out, so you are crying to the friendly crew member in the…

name: A Tour of Holland
description: This podcast serves as a platform for parents of children with special needs in order to gain insight, educate, and build community.

name: Autism Parenting Secrets
description: Are you a parent of a child with Autism? Are you ready to rise above the diagnosis? Each week on Autism Parenting Secrets, we are going to share how you can rise up and become the parent you need to be. Get personalized support at: elevatehowyounavigate.com

name: aVERY BRIGHT LIFE
description: aVERY BRIGHT LIFE isn't your typical parenting podcast. Mom, Lisa, shares honestly and humourously what she's learning about raising a child with disabilities. What makes this show unique is Avery herself, who is beautifully atypical.

name: Brave Together Podcast: Support and Community for Caregiving Parents
description: This is Brave Together Podcast. On Brave Together Podcast, co-hosts Jessica Patay, Susanna Peace Lovell and Dr. Zoe Shaw, will share interviews, celebrate stories, explore challenges, and rally hope for the motherhood journey.

name: Changing The Chances
description: Follow our hosts Alisha and Jesse Chance talk about their story growing and learning to be special needs parents. New episodes every Monday unless something explodes.

name: Changing Your Dreams: Parenting a Child with Special Needs
description: This podcast is about the unique grief we carry, changing our dreams, and how to care for ourselves when parenting a child with special needs.

name: Community Conversations
description: This podcast is a product of Be Love Company, and in it we take what's being taught from the pulpit and bring the topics to you here in the form of a conversation. To learn more about the church, visit beloveco.org.

name: Conversations with a SEND Mum
description: Welcome to 'Conversations with a SEND Mum' a podcast hosted by Nicole Bateman who is a SEND Mum herself and Co-Founder of The Super Sensory Squad.

name: Created For More
description: What if the biggest thing holding you back isn't your circumstances—but what you've come to believe? Do you feel stuck, even though you're trying to do all the right things? Are you longing for more peace, confidence, joy, purpose and intimacy?
hosts: Lenora Turner - Certified Coach, International Speaker

name: Dad to Dad  Podcast
description: Fathers mentoring fathers of kids with special needs - presented by the Special Fathers Network. Host David Hirsch interviews some amazing fathers of kids with special needs.

name: Disorderly Blondes Autism PODCAST
description: South Florida moms, Brenda and Kristi, candidly discuss MOTHERHOOD and AUTISM while balancing heels, cocktails, and meltdowns. They share the challenges and triumphs that define the parenting journey of their own special needs sons (autism spectrum disorder + CHRNA7 genetic duplication).

name: Embracing Autism
description: Your child is autistic, now what? Parenting a child is often rewarding, but for parents of autistic children, it can be a struggle when communication, finances, or behavior is a barrier.

name: Full Spectrum Parent: Christian Autism Support | Special Needs Parenting | Faith & Autism Resources
description: The Full Spectrum Parent Podcast is the only faith-based autism parenting podcast on the web. As pastors and special needs parents, each episode we offer parents a dose of help, a dose of humor, and a dose of hope. Full Spectrum Parent is a part of the Christian Parenting Podcast Network.

name: Full-Tilt Parenting: Strategies, Insights, and Connection for Parents Raising Neurodivergent Children
description: Feeling overwhelmed by the complexities of raising a neurodivergent child? Full-Tilt Parenting is here to help. Hosted by parenting activist and author Debbie Reber, this podcast is your go-to resource for navigating life with ADHD, autism, learning…

name: Having a Moment With Moni
description: From unfiltered conversations about motherhood, purpose, and resilience to powerful stories of navigating special needs, relationships, and self-growth, I bring transparency, humor, and heart to every episode. Nothing is off-limits, and every moment matters.

name: Hi Pod! I'm Dad.
description: Hi Pod! I’m Dad is where I talk through fatherhood while raising a son with autism who does not speak. I’m James Guttman, the dad behind Hi Blog! I’m Dad. This podcast isn’t about tips or solutions.

name: Holy Ground Parenting
description: Christian parenting in the special needs world. A faith-based, real life look at the highs and lows of special needs parenting from a mom living it.

name: Just Needs: parenting children with disabilities
description: Some people think of disabilities as "special needs." But as parents of children with disabilities, we know our kids just have needs... like everyone else.

name: Let’s Plant Houses
description: Let’s Plant Houses shares heartfelt stories from families living with autism, Down syndrome, cerebral palsy and other intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD).

name: LOMAH Disability Podcast
description: The LOMAH Podcast is an award winning show that runs topical series deep diving into an issue for 10-12 episodes with interviews from expert guests, including self advocates. Your host, Kim, has a teenage daughter with level 3 non speaking autism who will require 24/7 support the rest of her life.

name: Mama Marias, a Podcast for Caregivers
description: Mama Marias is a podcast for parents and caregivers of children with special needs of any kind. It is called Mama Marias because the two hosts are both named Maria and each has a daughter with special needs.

name: Meltdowns and Moscato
description: Jaci and Joey delve into their lives as Special Needs Parents. They provide an insight into raising children with autism by sharing relatable stories. They share tips and tricks that they used and things they wish they would have known years earlier.

name: Moments of Joy
description: This podcast is dedicated to the parent raising a child with special needs, the parent caregiver, the strongest group of parents in the world! This community welcomes you!

name: Moms Talk Autism Podcast
description: The Moms Talk Autism Podcast is for parents raising children with special needs. We are four moms, all with autistic children and other neurodivergence. Teaching a special needs child to navigate the world around them comes with challenges and struggles.
hosts: Shannon Korza, Brittney Crabtree, Jean Mayer, Natasha Hayes-Dillmon

name: Mother's Guide Through Autism
description: This podcast is to inspire, support, and build community for mothers raising children with autism. Brigitte Shipman is the host and creator of this podcast and it has been inspired by her son Joseph who has been living with autism for the last 32 years.

name: Neurolicious - by Mummel Road
description: Parenting is a tough gig—but parenting a child with additional needs brings unique challenges, emotions, and incredible moments of growth.

name: Not Your Average Autism Mom
description: This podcast was started for parents and caregivers raising autistic children, but has evolved, and we have listeners across the world who are relatives of someone with autism, special education teachers, and other professionals.

name: Overcome the Overwhelm for Special Needs Moms
description: Overcome the Overwhelm for Special Needs Moms is your go-to podcast for breaking through the emotional struggles of raising a child with a disability.

name: Parenting Autism
description: Your hosts are Chris and Sandy Colter, the parents of Bryce, who share their autism journey with stories about their nine year old son who was diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder at age two.

name: Parenting Pivot
description: Helping parents of neurodivergent and special needs kids feel less alone. Real stories. Expert advice. Actionable support. Whether you're navigating a new diagnosis or just trying to make it through the week, you're not alone.

name: Parenting Severe Autism
description: Parenting Severe Autism is a raw, unfiltered podcast for parents and caregivers raising children with Severe Autism. Hosted by Shannon Chamberlin - a parent, not a professional - this show is your emotional lifeline, real-talk resource, and reminder that you're not alone.

name: Permission to Breathe for Special Needs Parents
description: This is Permission to Breathe, the mini-cast show dedicated to parents of children with special needs. We’re igniting Dual-Dream Advocacy, where your own hopes, well-being, and future matter just as much as your child’s.

name: Pieces For My Puzzle
description:
Welcome to the Pieces For My Puzzle Podcast, where I, Nikki Shipp, invite you to join me on a journey through the intricacies of life as a wife to a dedicated police officer and a mother to an incredible autistic son.

As a parent navigating the…

name: Raising Kellan
description: An information hub for parents of children with disabilities.

name: Rare Mamas Rising: A Rare Disease Mom Podcast
description: Rare Mamas Rising is a podcast for mothers of children with rare diseases to find strategies, strength, support, and sisterhood! Hosted by Nikki McIntosh, founder of Rare Mamas, author of the book Rare Mamas: Empowering Strategies for Navigating Your Child's…

name: Safe Harbor: A Podcast for Parents of Children with Disabilities
description: The Safe Harbor Podcast is for parents of children with disabilities. This show enables parents to come together as a community to share, learn and support each other on this complex path.

name: Special Needs Parenting SOS
description: Help, hope, encouragement and support for parents who have a child with special needs. Caring for a child with special needs has several challenges and I don’t want you to feel like you are all alone.

name: Specialness Pod
description: Welcome to Specialness, the YouTube channel where love, resilience, and the extraordinary journey of parenting a special needs child take center stage.

name: Take Heart
description: The mind of Christian teenagers trying to love Jesus and his people in a world that doesn’t always love it. I hope you enjoy our laughter and stories as we seek to take heart in who Jesus has called us to be!
hosts: Amy J Brown, Carrie M. Holt, Sara Clime

name: The Autism Dad
description: The Autism Dad podcast delivers autism parenting support, special needs advice, and real stories for families raising neurodivergent kids.

name: The Autism Mom Coach
description: Do you sometimes feel like your life has been hijacked by Autism? If so, this is the podcast for you. The Autism Mom Coach is a podcast for moms who feel overwhelmed, afraid, and sometimes powerless as they raise their child with Autism.

name: The Odyssey: Parenting. Caregiving. Disability.
description: The Odyssey podcast explores the unique journey we're sent on when a loved one has a disability. We dig deep into the joys and hardships. We celebrate how amazing the odyssey of parenting, caregiving, and disability are. But we don't shy away from the tough stuff either.

name: The Parenting Cipher
description: The Parenting Cipher is the podcast for innovative Black parents raising neurodiverse and special needs children who want clear answers, fresh strategies, and a supportive community.

name: The Polaris Connection Autism Parenting, Expert Insights & Proven Resources
description: The Polaris Connection is the ultimate autism parenting podcast for families, caregivers, and professionals navigating the world of autism and special needs.

name: The Rare Life
description: This is the real, raw, and all the feels of loving a child with disabilities. Episodes feature parent-guests, professionals, and solo episodes with host Madeline Cheney. Their authentic conversations don’t shy away from the strong and mixed emotions that often accompany medically-complex parenting.

name: The SEND Mum Club
description: The SEND Mum Club is the parenting podcast with a difference. Made specifically for parents of children with all kinds of additional needs and disabilities.

name: The SEND Parents Survival Guide
description: Welcome to The SEND Parenting Survival Guide podcast, guiding you through the SEND parenting maze. My name is Esther Freeman, and I teach people the techniques and principals that helped my daughter go from five or six violent meltdowns a day to zero.

name: The Skies We’re Under
description: Nurse, author and Director of Born at the Right Time, Rachel Wright talks to fellow parents of people with disabilities and others in their community.

name: The Special Needs Mom Podcast
description: Think of this podcast as your very own special needs mom support group--except it's helpful and fun! You will leave with the hope that you can have a super happy life even when your life includes parenting a medically complex child or a child with something like autism and ADHD.

name: The Special Needs Parent Podcast
description: Our efforts for our children can be overwhelming (decimating and fulfilling, heart-warming and heart-breaking, thrilling and scary). Despite all the love and joy we feel with our precious children and family, the journey can also drain us.

name: This Unexpected Life
description: Welcome to This Unexpected Life , a podcast designed to equip and encourage parents and caregivers of children with disabilities so they can embrace their journey with hope, faith, and resilience.

name: Thriving in the Midst of Chaos: Parenting With Special Needs Kids
description: Welcome to Thriving in the Midst of Chaos! This show is about surviving parenthood while having a child with special needs, while attempting to keep your self and your sanity intact. We share our experiences and discuss how we survived, what worked for us, and what didn't work for us.

name: Together Through the Storms
description: My name is Niina. I’m a mum to two Deaf daughters and a special education teacher, learning alongside you as we navigate the ups and downs of parenting children with additional needs.

name: Unexceptional Moms
description: Welcome to the Unexceptional Moms Podcast, where we offer hope and encouragement for parents of disabled kids. Join us in this journey as we navigate the joys and challenges of raising children with disabilities. We want you to know you're not alone.

name: Water Prairie Chronicles Podcast
description: The Water Prairie Chronicles podcast is a valuable resource for parents of children with disabilities and special needs. Hosted by Tonya Wollum, the podcast features interviews with a variety of guests, including adults who have grown up with disabilities,…

name: When Autumn Comes: Seasons of Hope for Medical + Disability Moms
description: We call ourselves the 4am Mom Club because more nights than not, our kids are awake at 4am. We both have very medical, complicated, rare, beautiful children. This is a podcast for medical and disability mamas (and the people who love them) who are facing a life they never expected.
